answer.text: Allow participants to hedge/speculate on commodity price movements

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Commodity derivatives cover gold, silver, base metals, agri — hedge or price discovery. **The Trap:** They are regulated (SEBI) post-2015 merger. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same in XVI (Commodity Derivatives). **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Commodity PMS IAs exist — understand margining and delivery settlement.
